draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. You've got a first project up and a teammate invited, which is the hard part done -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
